title: Ring that matches the hotbar icon
desc: J: "why dont i have a ring that looks accurately like the one in my item bar". Four takes build the icon's head on R19d's band (I1-I4); the other way, icons N1-N3 showing R19d, are 16x16 PNGs in the review folder.

takes.name: Icon true - octagon gem
takes.facts: the hotbar icon's head on R19d's band: domed octagon gem, light corner top-left; X5 ripple emerald panels; lights up frames 20-44 (gem first, then panels), stays bright; turntable one turn per 200 frames
takes.cam3p: Cam I1 Icon true - octagon gem

takes.name: Square-cut gem
takes.facts: icon head with a stepped square gem (flat table plus 3 steps); X5 ripple emerald panels; lights up frames 20-44 (gem first, then panels), stays bright; turntable one turn per 200 frames

takes.name: Emerald-cut gem, weave panels
takes.facts: icon head with a tall cut-corner stepped gem; W1 neon weave panels; lights up frames 20-44 (gem first, then panels), stays bright; turntable one turn per 200 frames
takes.cam3p: Cam I3 Emerald-cut gem, weave panels

takes.name: Icon frame, R19d's square inside
takes.facts: R19d's light-cut concentric square inside the icon's gold frame; H1 neon hex panels; lights up frames 20-44 (gem first, then panels), stays bright; turntable one turn per 200 frames
takes.cam3p: Cam I4 Icon frame, R19d's square inside

takes.name: Concentric square - big face + halo
takes.facts: R19d unchanged, for comparison; lights up frames 20-44 (gem first, then panels), stays bright; turntable one turn per 200 frames
takes.cam3p: Cam R19d Concentric square - big face + halo
